gold.user: User wants to delete a specific media attachment from a message sent through Twilio. They have the Account SID, Message SID, and Media SID ready to make the request.
gold.ideal: Successfully deletes the specified media attachment and returns a 204 No Content response.

gold.user: User needs to retrieve details about a specific media attachment associated with a message. They have the necessary Account SID, Message SID, and Media SID to fetch the data.
